candidate_evidence.quote: This phase II trial studies the effect of avapritinib in treating malignant solid tumors that have a genetic change (mutation) in CKIT or PDGFRA

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients must have received prior treatment with radiation and concurrent temozolomide per standard of care.
Cohorts 1 and 2: Patient has a locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor and has progressed on appropriate standard therapy

role_evidence.quote: Patients receive avapritinib PO QD on days 1-28.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: Avapritinib may stop the growth of tumor cells by blocking some of the enzymes needed for cell growth.

source_quote.quote: Cohort 3 should have pathogenic CKIT or PDGFRA activating mutation/amplification based on CLIA-certified NGS diagnostic test.

coder_notes: Tissue-agnostic KIT/PDGFRA basket; glioblastoma named in inclusion criteria (Cohort 3, newly diagnosed IDH-wt MGMT-unmethylated GBM after chemoradiation). Cohorts are not registered arm labels (single arm 'Treatment (avapritinib)'), so biomarker arms left empty; IDH/MGMT apply to Cohort 3 only (enrichment). KIT/PDGFRA alteration is required for all cohorts (mutation for cohorts 1-2, mutation/amplification for cohort 3). Treatment setting 'both': GBM cohort is first-line post-chemoradiation, other cohorts advanced/refractory. Prior temozolomide is history, not a study agent. Adolescents 12+ also allowed per inclusion text.
